title: Corso in post-war Italy, Knight of Malta

tellings.quote: Colonel Philip J. Corso, later famous for his claims regarding reverse engineering alien materials at the Pentagon in his book, The Day After Roswell, served as a high-ranking intelligence officer in Italy during the post-war period.

plain: Colonel Philip J. Corso, an Army officer who later became famous for his book The Day After Roswell, in which he claimed the Pentagon reverse engineered alien materials, served as a high-ranking intelligence officer in Italy after the Second World War. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the former presidential advisor Harald Malmgren. He raises it to place Corso in the secret postwar intelligence world long before his later claims.
